translations.web: “ ‘You sword of Yahweh, how long will it be before you are quiet? Put yourself back into your scabbard; rest, and be still.’
translations.bsb: ‘Alas, O sword of the LORD, how long until you rest? Return to your sheath; cease and be still!’
translations.kjv: O thou sword of the LORD, how long will it be ere thou be quiet? put up thyself into thy scabbard, rest, and be still.
translations.asv: O thou sword of Jehovah, how long will it be ere thou be quiet? put up thyself into thy scabbard; rest, and be still.
